bio: Personal Website: http://www.michaelwalton.info Michael Walton is Senior Lecturer Emeritus in Public Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, Senior Visiting Fellow at the Centre for Policy Research, Delhi. He was VKRV Rao Chair Professor, Institute of Social and Economic Change, Bangalore for 2008 and 2009.
